listings.name: Custom photo magnets
listings.title: Custom Photo Magnets, Personalized 2x2 Fridge Magnets from Your Photos, Handmade Picture Magnet Set Gift
listings.description:
Your favorite photos, made into glossy 2 x 2 inch fridge magnets by hand. A little gallery for the fridge, the filing cabinet or a gift that actually gets used.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose your pack size.
2. Upload your photos in the personalization boxes (up to 10 per box).
3. Tell us your frame and caption, or leave it to us. See the frame styles in the photos.
We crop every photo to a square and touch up the light and color by hand. If someone must stay in the frame, just tell us.

WHAT YOU GET
2 x 2 inch square magnets with square corners, a glossy front and a strong magnet back. One photo per magnet. You can repeat a photo as many times as you like.

BEST PHOTOS
Use the original photo from your camera roll. Screenshots and photos saved from chat apps are often too small and print blurry. If a photo is too small, we message you before printing.

MADE BY HAND, TO ORDER
We print, press and pack every magnet ourselves, in our small studio. Your order ships in 1 to 2 business days with USPS tracking.

SHIPPING
Free US shipping on orders of $35 or more.

PACK OF 50
Upload 30 photos here and we will message you for the rest.

Questions? Send us a message. A real person reads every one and replies within one business day.
listings.personalization: Upload your photos and tell us your frame and captions, or leave it to us.
listings.alt: Custom photo magnets made by Little Hive House
